## Meaning

This monitor fired because a fixed threshold was crossed.

Query:

```
max(last_1h):max:acme.observability.managed_monitor_count{__SCOPE__} > 1500
```

**Why this threshold is a fixed number.** The monitor budget from global.yaml. Crossing it means the framework's bounded-object invariant has been violated and monitor sprawl has begun.

## Impact

Observability or configuration hygiene is degraded. No direct customer impact, but our ability to see or govern the estate is reduced.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-platform-services`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-ticket-sustained` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `create_servicenow_task`, `link_monitor`, `notify_team_channel`.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `observability-platform` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P4 — next business day; this never pages.
